title: 第12章 日记第13章 占卜
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
指尖拂过那冰凉的金属标牌，莫甘娜心中那点因被迫选择而产生的不耐烦悄然散去，取而代之的是一丝兴味。
太久没看收藏了，重新看一看的话，也许能找到之前的——新鲜感？
轻轻拨开卡扣，掀开了盒盖。
首先映入眼帘的，是一本厚实的、以深蓝色硬壳装订的笔记。
笔记的封皮没有任何文字，在笔记旁边，则是一本体积小得多，但制作同样精良的书籍。
它的封面上，是用赫密斯语写的标题——《罗塞尔·古斯塔夫本纪》。
看到这本书，莫甘娜的嘴角几不可察地微微牵动了一下。
在确认了那位大名鼎鼎的罗塞尔大帝是穿越者之后，莫甘娜曾一度狂热地想要收集所有关于他的一切。
作为维斯珀家备受“宠爱”的女儿，她的父亲奥莱尔，那位近些年才出现的子爵，几乎是毫不犹豫地满足了她的愿望。
奥莱尔很是豪迈的招揽了十几位在因蒂斯历史、尤其是罗塞尔时期有着深入研究，甚至不乏一些持不同政见观点的学者，秘密编纂了这本《罗塞尔·古斯塔夫本纪》。
书名当然是莫甘娜提供的，她承认她有点恶趣味，但是也没有人知道本纪是什么意思嘛，所以没有问题。
而内容，则由那些学者们编写的，主打一个“客观”与“真实”。
结果可想而知。
这本书一出现，立刻在因蒂斯国内引起了轩然大波。
过于“客观”的笔触，触碰了太多官方试图掩盖或美化的历史神经。
为了“国家的和平与稳定”，这本《本纪》遭到了帝国官方的全面查禁，几乎在一夜之间绝版，成为了只能在某些隐秘的收藏家手中或地下渠道里才能偶尔窥见的禁忌之物。
莫甘娜只能遗憾的悄悄收藏一本咯。
目光掠过这两本书，落在了盒子最底层。
那里安静地躺着一张对折的便笺，以及……三张纸。
莫甘娜将它们拿了出来。

哦——是之前提过的亵渎之牌。
三张卡片大小比常见的塔罗牌小一点，看上去就是很普通的三张纸，上面是极其丑的、疑似罗塞尔的自画像，只不过每一个内容各有不同。
第一张，描绘着璀璨夺目的太阳，光芒万丈，充满生机与力量，而罗塞尔站在前面，双手张开像在挥洒光芒。
第二张，则是一位顶天立地的巨人罗塞尔，身披黄昏般的光辉，脚下是破碎的兵刃与战场，透着无尽的威严与力量感，可因为极丑的画风，显得很怪异。
第三张，则是一座耸入云霄、却被雷霆击中而燃烧崩塌的高塔，而无数的小罗塞尔从高处落下来。
——太阳、黄昏巨人、高塔，这是系统告诉莫甘娜的名字。
这三张亵渎之牌，都是在父亲成堆的收藏里面找到的，只能说，要不是有系统提示，莫甘娜就要找不到他们了。
content_en:
As her fingertips brushed against the cold metal sign, the impatience in Morgana's heart caused by the forced choice quietly dissipated, replaced by a trace of interest.
It’s been a long time since I’ve looked at the collection. If I look at it again, maybe I can find the freshness?
Gently push the buckle open and lift the lid.
The first thing that caught my eye was a thick notebook bound in a dark blue hard case.
There is no text on the cover of the note. Next to the note is a much smaller but equally well-made book.
On its cover is the title written in Hermetic - "The Chronicles of Russell Gustav".
Seeing this book, the corners of Morgana's mouth twitched slightly, almost imperceptibly.
After confirming that the famous Emperor Russell was a time traveler, Morgana once feverishly wanted to collect everything about him.
As the "favored" daughter of the Vesper family, her father Aurel, the Viscount who had only appeared in recent years, fulfilled her wishes almost without hesitation.
Orel very boldly recruited a dozen scholars who had in-depth research on the history of Intis, especially the Russell period, and even some scholars with dissident views, to secretly compile this "The Chronicles of Russell Gustav".
The title of the book was of course provided by Morgana. She admitted that she had a bit of a bad taste, but no one knew what Ben Ji meant, so there was no problem.
The content, written by scholars, focuses on "objectivity" and "truth."
The results can be imagined.
As soon as this book appeared, it immediately caused an uproar in Intis.
The overly "objective" approach touches too many historical nerves that the authorities are trying to cover up or beautify.
For the sake of "national peace and stability", this "Benji" was completely banned by imperial officials and went out of print almost overnight, becoming a taboo that could only be seen occasionally in the hands of some secret collectors or underground channels.
Morgana can only secretly collect a copy with regret.
His eyes passed over the two books and landed on the bottom of the box.
Lying there quietly was a folded note and... three pieces of paper.
Morgana took them out.
Oh—it’s the blasphemy card I mentioned before.
The three cards are a little smaller than common tarot cards. They look like three ordinary pieces of paper. On them are extremely ugly self-portraits that appear to be Russell's, but the content of each one is different.
The first picture depicts the dazzling sun, shining brightly, full of vitality and power, while Russell stands in front, with his hands open as if radiating light.
The second picture shows a towering giant Russell, clothed in dusk-like glory, with broken weapons and battlefields at his feet. He exudes an endless sense of majesty and power, but because of the extremely ugly painting style, it looks very strange.
The third picture is of a tower that towered into the sky, but was struck by thunder and burned and collapsed, while countless little Russells fell from the height.
——Sun, Twilight Giant, Tower, these are the names the system told Morgana.
These three cards of blasphemy were all found in his father's piles of collections. It can only be said that if there were no system prompts, Morgana would not be able to find them.
